title.zh: 授权菲律宾群岛公共卫生专员在民政长官批准下，指派各省卫生委员会主席及各市镇卫生委员会主席赴本省或本市镇以外地区履职，并规定其履职期间差旅费与食宿费支付办法，同时在菲律宾群岛卫生委员会增设若干职位，并规定所设职位薪金支付办法的法案
title.en: AN ACT AUTHORIZING THE COMMISSIONER OF PUBLIC HEALTH, WITH THE APPROVAL OF THE CIVIL GOVERNOR, TO ASSIGN PRESIDENTS OF PROVINCIAL BOARDS OF HEALTH AND PRESIDENTS OF MUNICIPAL BOARDS OF HEALTH TO DUTY OUTSIDE THEIR PROVINCES OR MUNICIPALITIES, PROVIDING FOR THE PAYMENT OF THEIR TRAVELING EXPENSES AND SUBSISTENCE WHILE SO ASSIGNED, CREATING CERTAIN ADDITIONAL POSITIONS IN THE BOARD OF HEALTH FOR THE PHILIPPINE ISLANDS, AND MAKING PROVISION FOR THE PAYMENT OF THE SALARIES OF THE POSITIONS SO CREATED.
title.orig: AN ACT AUTHORIZING THE COMMISSIONER OF PUBLIC HEALTH, WITH THE APPROVAL OF THE CIVIL GOVERNOR, TO ASSIGN PRESIDENTS OF PROVINCIAL BOARDS OF HEALTH AND PRESIDENTS OF MUNICIPAL BOARDS OF HEALTH TO DUTY OUTSIDE THEIR PROVINCES OR MUNICIPALITIES, PROVIDING FOR THE PAYMENT OF THEIR TRAVELING EXPENSES AND SUBSISTENCE WHILE SO ASSIGNED, CREATING CERTAIN ADDITIONAL POSITIONS IN THE BOARD OF HEALTH FOR THE PHILIPPINE ISLANDS, AND MAKING PROVISION FOR THE PAYMENT OF THE SALARIES OF THE POSITIONS SO CREATED.
title.vi: Đạo luật ủy quyền cho Ủy viên Y tế Công cộng, với sự chấp thuận của Thống đốc Dân sự, bổ nhiệm Chủ tịch Hội đồng Y tế Tỉnh và Chủ tịch Hội đồng Y tế Thị trấn làm nhiệm vụ ngoài tỉnh hoặc thị trấn của họ, quy định chi trả chi phí đi lại và sinh hoạt trong thời gian thực hiện nhiệm vụ đó, tạo ra một số vị trí bổ sung trong Hội đồng Y tế Quần đảo Philippines và quy định chi trả lương cho các vị trí mới được tạo ra
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติมอบอำนาจให้ผู้บัญชาการสาธารณสุขสามารถแต่งตั้งประธานคณะกรรมการสาธารณสุขจังหวัดและประธานคณะกรรมการสาธารณสุขเทศบาลไปปฏิบัติหน้าที่นอกจังหวัดหรือเทศบาลของตนได้โดยได้รับความเห็นชอบจากผู้ว่าราชการพลเรือนและกำหนดให้มีการจ่ายค่าใช้จ่ายในการเดินทางและค่าครองชีพในระหว่างที่ปฏิบัติหน้าที่ดังกล่าวรวมทั้งจัดตั้งตำแหน่งเพิ่มเติมบางตำแหน่งในคณะกรรมการสาธารณสุขหมู่เกาะฟิลิปปินส์และกำหนดให้มีการจ่ายเงินเดือนสำหรับตำแหน่งที่จัดตั้งขึ้นดังกล่าว
title.id: Undang-Undang mengizinkan Komisaris Kesehatan Masyarakat, dengan persetujuan Gubernur Sipil, menugaskan Presiden Dewan Kesehatan Provinsi dan Presiden Dewan Kesehatan Kota untuk bertugas di luar provinsi atau kotanya, mengatur pembayaran biaya perjalanan dan tunjangan hidup selama penugasan tersebut, menciptakan beberapa posisi tambahan di Dewan Kesehatan Kepulauan Filipina, serta mengatur pembayaran gaji untuk posisi-posisi yang diciptakan tersebut
title.ms: Akta memberi kuasa kepada Pesuruhjaya Kesihatan Awam dengan kelulusan Gabenor Sivil untuk melantik Presiden Majlis Kesihatan Wilayah dan Presiden Majlis Kesihatan Bandaraya menjalankan tugas di luar wilayah atau bandaraya mereka, menetapkan pembayaran perbelanjaan perjalanan dan saraan semasa tugasan sedemikian, mencipta jawatan tambahan tertentu dalam Majlis Kesihatan Kepulauan Filipina dan membuat peruntukan bagi pembayaran gaji jawatan-jawatan yang dicipta sedemikian

text.en:
The Commissioner of Public Health is hereby authorized, subject to the approval of the Civil
Governor, to assign presidents of provincial boards of health to temporary duty outside the province in which
they are regularly located. The traveling expenses and subsistence of presidents of provincial boards of
health so1 assigned shall be paid during such assignment from the Insular Treasury.
The Commissioner of Public Health is further authorized, when in his judgment such a course is in the public
interest, to assign presidents of municipal boards of health to temporary duty outside the municipalities in
which they are regularly located. The traveling expenses and subsistence of presidents of municipal boards
of health so assigned shall be paid during such assignment from the Insular Treasury.

The Commissioner of Public Health is hereby authorized to appoint the following employees for
the purpose of initiating the work of immunizing the cattle and carabaos of the Philippine Islands against
rinderpest: Two veterinarians of class seven and ten inoculators of Class A.

The payment of the salaries of the positions herein created, and of the traveling expenses and
subsistence of presidents of provincial and municipal boards of health when assigned in accordance with the
provisions of section one of this Act, for the fiscal year nineteen hundred and three, is hereby authorized out
of funds appropriated in Act Numbered Five hundred and ninety-five under the heading "Suppression and
extermination of epidemic diseases and pests, Board of Health for the Philippine Islands, nineteen hundred

This Act shall be retroactive in so far as necessary to authorize the payment from the Insular
Treasury of the traveling expenses and subsistence of Doctor F. W. Dudley, president of the provincial board
of health of Pampanga, who was assigned by the Commissioner of Public Health on February twentieth,
nineteen hundred and three, to duty outside the Province of Pampanga.

The public good requiring the speedy enactment of this bill, the passage of the same is hereby
expedited in accordance with section two of "An Act prescribing the order of procedure by the Commission
in the enactment of laws," passed September twenty-sixth, nineteen hundred.

This Act shall take effect on its passage.
Enacted, March 12, 1903.
